repo_notes.content: This is an Android app (MuseTube) that wraps the YouTube Music web player (music.youtube.com) in a WebView. It injects custom JS/CSS to block ads/analytics, spoof a desktop browser fingerprint, add custom player controls, drive a media notification + Android Auto, and download tracks offline. Written in Kotlin using Jetpack Compose, forked from MuseMobile (a Spotify WebView wrapper) and ported phase by phase; see project.md for the phase log. Priority areas: webview/ (JS injection engine), service/ (media + offline playback), offline/ + innertube/ + yt/ (YouTube-backed offline downloads), and bridge/ (JS <-> Kotlin).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: webview/ holds the core engine. MusicWebViewClient orchestrates per-page JS injection and request interception; MusicWebChromeClient handles fullscreen/custom view, child login windows (music/google/youtube allowlist) and progress. webview/injections/ contains 32 Kotlin objects, each exposing a const val CONTENT with raw JavaScript (BrowserSpoof, FetchOverride, PlayerCore, YtmTrackObserver, MediaUpdater, PlaybackControls, YtmAuto, MainLoop, AutoFeatures, PowerSave, SearchOverlay, DownloadButton, DownloadProgress, CssHack, MuseTubePlayer, FbGdprBypass, YtmLoginDetection, GoogleSpoof, WorkerNeutralize, YtmAdblock, GaBlocker, SettingsFix, ModalFix, ErrorDialogRestyle, ToastFix, LyricsSyncFix, ClassicBridge, CollectionDownload, ContextMenuDownload, QueueAutoClose, LibraryAutoClose, VideoPark). Order of injection in injectPlayerControl matters (PlayerCore defines globals first). webview/helpers/ has JsUtils (console log stripping), AmoledTheme, CssInjector, AdBlocker, AdIdStore, DevLogPrelude. YtmAuto.kt is the Android Auto media-browser/search JS (fetchMediaItems, searchMediaItems over youtubei/v1/browse+search via AndBridge.nFetch with SAPISIDHASH). Retired stubs: SearchOverlay, QueueAutoClose, LibraryAutoClose (YTM needs none of them).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: service/ contains MediaNotificationService (a MediaBrowserServiceCompat providing lock-screen controls and Android Auto browsing/search/playback via MediaSessionCompat, wakeAndRun to resume a backgrounded WebView, Bluetooth/noisy audio routing, custom actions for favorite/shuffle/repeat; Auto context ids are FEmusic_*/VL*/MPRE*/UC*/RD*/LM/videoId) and OfflineMediaService (foreground player for downloaded tracks). bridge/ contains MusicBridge which exposes @JavascriptInterface methods to the WebView JS context (AndBridge): media status/position, media items + search results for Android Auto, download track/collection payloads, PiP requests, login/playLoaded signals, and a native fetch fallback (nFetch, YTM Origin/Referer) used for youtubei calls.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: offline/ (DownloadManager, OfflineStore) implements YouTube Music offline downloads into Music/MuseTube/ as 'Artist - Title [videoId].m4a'. WebView payloads already carry the exact 11-char videoId so DownloadManager resolves directly via yt/ and only falls back to text search for legacy payloads; audio comes from the custom InnerTube API client under innertube/ (InnerTube, YouTube, models/, pages/, utils/), then streamable URLs under yt/ (YTPlayerUtils, AudioQuality, CandidateScorer, cipher/ with PlayerJsFetcher + CipherDeobfuscator, potoken/ PoToken generation, sabr/ streaming parser). profile/ has ProfileManager for Google account profiles (SAPISID-gated cookie domains). util/ has UpdateChecker + GitHubApi (release checking against ThinuxBOOM/musetube), DebugLogStore, Markdown, Constants (YTM_HOME/GOOGLE_LOGIN/DESKTOP_UA). proxy/ has LocalProxyManager (optional MITM local proxy with generated MuseTube CA cert, generic - no per-host logic). ui/ has Compose screens: SplashActivity, MainActivity (WebView host + player overlay), OfflineActivity, screens/SettingsScreen, plus theme/ (MuseTubeTheme, Saira font family, AMOLED dark theme).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: High-level architecture of MuseTube: how the WebView, JS injection engine, Android services, Android Auto integration, and the YouTube-backed offline downloader interact to wrap and enhance the YouTube Music web player

pages.title: WebView & JS Injection System
pages.purpose: How MusicWebViewClient orchestrates JS injection on each page load (onPageStarted vs onPageFinished vs injectPlayerControl), which injections are gated on login state, how YtmLoginDetection replaces the old login/logout checks, and how MusicWebChromeClient handles child windows and fullscreen video

pages.title: JS Injection Objects Reference
pages.purpose: Detailed reference for each of the 32 JS injection objects in webview/injections/ - what each one does, its key exported window functions/variables, and when it is injected. Cover ad-blocking (YtmAdblock, GaBlocker, WorkerNeutralize, FetchOverride adPlacements stripping), spoofing (BrowserSpoof, GoogleSpoof, desktop fingerprint), player core + globals (PlayerCore, YtmTrackObserver, MediaUpdater, PlaybackControls), Android Auto JS (YtmAuto), UI features (CssHack, MuseTubePlayer, AutoFeatures, PowerSave, DownloadButton, DownloadProgress, CollectionDownload, ContextMenuDownload, YtmLoginDetection), and page helpers (FbGdprBypass, ClassicBridge, SettingsFix, ModalFix, ErrorDialogRestyle, ToastFix, LyricsSyncFix, MainLoop, VideoPark) plus retired stubs (SearchOverlay, QueueAutoClose, LibraryAutoClose)

pages.title: Helper Utilities
pages.purpose: Documentation of webview/helpers/: JsUtils (console.log stripping algorithm + cache), AmoledTheme (AMOLED CSS builder for ytmusic-app), CssInjector (custom CSS injection), AdBlocker + AdIdStore (YTM analytics/ad marker blocking and request-id tracking; music and ads share the googlevideo CDN so only ad-only markers match), DevLogPrelude (debug overlay logging hooks)

pages.title: Kotlin-JS Bridge (MusicBridge)
pages.purpose: Document every @JavascriptInterface method exposed to the WebView as window.AndBridge: loginDetected, playLoaded, deferMessage, isWoke/wakeUp/wakeOff, cssInjected, recMediaStatus/recMediaPosition, recAccountName, onMediaItemsLoaded/onSearchCompleted (Android Auto), downloadTrack/downloadCollection, skipDownload/cancelDownload, enterPip/enterPipVideo, openTimerDialog, manageTShut/manageTSleep, dbg, recAdContentIds, and the nFetch native-fetch fallback (YTM Origin/Referer, 2MiB cap) used for youtubei calls

pages.title: Media Notification & Android Auto Service
pages.purpose: How MediaNotificationService (a MediaBrowserServiceCompat) provides: the foreground media notification, lock-screen/Bluetooth/Wear controls via MediaSessionCompat, Android Auto root categories (playlists/albums/artists/podcasts) + async onLoadChildren/onSearch with pendingCallbacks and timeouts, onPlayFromMediaId + wakeAndRun (resumeTimers/onResume/visibility) to execute JS while the WebView is backgrounded, custom actions (favorite/shuffle/repeat), Bluetooth/noisy audio auto pause/resume, and metadata/cover art loading

pages.title: Android Auto Media Browsing Flow
pages.purpose: End-to-end flow for Android Auto: onGetRoot extras, root categories, JS fetchMediaItems/searchMediaItems over youtubei/v1/browse+search via nFetch with SAPISIDHASH (ytcfg context preferred), shelf/carousel/grid parsers, JSON payload parsing (name/id/image/artists/browsable flags) back in Kotlin onMediaItemsLoaded/onSearchCompleted, and playback via playFromUri(mediaId, contextId) navigating to watch/playlist/browse URLs

pages.title: Offline Playback Service
pages.purpose: How OfflineMediaService plays downloaded tracks as a foreground service with its own MediaSession, and how it relates to the offline/ store (OfflineStore) and the main webview player

pages.title: Offline Downloads (YouTube-backed)
pages.purpose: How the offline downloader works: DownloadManager consumes a YTM videoId payload from JS (DownloadButton/DownloadProgress/CollectionDownload/ContextMenuDownload), resolves the stream directly (search+scorer fallback), downloads ranged audio, and stores Music/MuseTube/'Artist - Title [videoId].m4a' via OfflineStore for OfflineMediaService

pages.title: YouTube InnerTube Client
pages.purpose: Documentation of innertube/: the custom InnerTube API client (InnerTube.kt with SAPISIDHASH auth, YouTube.kt search/player/visitorData), WEB_REMIX client constants (YouTubeClient.kt), serialized models under models/, pagination/search under pages/, and utils/ - including how search and player responses are parsed for the offline downloader

pages.title: YouTube Audio Extraction & Cipher
pages.purpose: Documentation of yt/: YTPlayerUtils, AudioQuality selection, CandidateScorer, and the signature-cipher deobfuscation (cipher/ with PlayerJsFetcher + CipherDeobfuscator), PoToken/anti-bot generation (potoken/), and SABR streaming (sabr/) used to resolve playable audio streams

pages.title: MITM Proxy System
pages.purpose: How LocalProxyManager implements an optional local man-in-the-middle proxy with generated MuseTube CA certificates to present a desktop fingerprint, plus the network_security_config and why this mode is optional vs the default normal mode

pages.title: UI Layer
pages.purpose: Documentation of ui/: MainActivity (Jetpack Compose host for the WebView, custom player overlay, PiP handling, sleep timer, service start/stop), SplashActivity (loading + CA-gate screens), OfflineActivity (downloaded tracks UI), screens/SettingsScreen (all preferences: AndAuto/Android Auto, APlayMode, ConnectionMode normal/proxy, AmoledTheme, CustomCss, BtAutoPause/Resume, sleep timer, PlayerMode musetube/original, profiles), and theme/ (MuseTubeTheme, Saira font family, AMOLED dark theme)

pages.title: Profile Manager
pages.purpose: How ProfileManager stores, switches, saves, and deletes Google account profiles (SAPISID-gated cookie capture across music/accounts/youtube domains, encrypted prefs) and how it interacts with the avatar-name detection in the JS bridge

pages.title: Utilities
pages.purpose: Documentation of util/: UpdateChecker + GitHubApi (release version checking against ThinuxBOOM/musetube releases), Constants (DESKTOP_UA/YTM_HOME/GOOGLE_LOGIN), DebugLogStore (in-memory ring buffer surfaced in the debug overlay), and Markdown (rendering helper)

pages.title: Build & Configuration
pages.purpose: Build system (Gradle Kotlin DSL + version catalog gradle/libs.versions.toml; gradle-wrapper.jar is gitignored so build with a local Gradle dist), module structure (app/), ProGuard keep rules for JS bridge and BouncyCastle, deferred Firebase google-services.json + release keystore setup, local.properties sdk.dir, AndroidManifest declarations (services, Android Auto automotive_app_desc meta-data), and network security config
